artifacts.summary: Corrected 12 wrong `bash scripts/deploy-headless.sh` invocation sites across 6 source-store files (the canonical regeneration doc plus 5 core scripts), added a mechanical regression guard, deployed clean, and confirmed zero regressions against a green 34-check baseline.

completion_data.completion_summary: Corrected the wrong deploy-headless.sh invocation path in regeneration-is-manual-only.md and 5 core scripts (12 defect sites, all under agent-system/extensions/core/), added a regression guard to check-extension-docs.sh, and deployed the fix clean (RESULT=landed_verify_clean, exit 0) with zero gate regressions.

memory_candidates.content: When a source-store/deployed-tree repo scans its own docs for a wrong-invocation regression pattern (e.g. grep -rn 'bash scripts/foo.sh'), any explanatory comment placed near the check that spells the defect string literally becomes a self-inflicted false positive -- the check's own grep matches its own prose. Fix by rendering the defect string in comments with the same escaped-literal form used in the grep pattern itself (e.g. 'foo\.sh' instead of 'foo.sh'), which does not match the unescaped literal grep pattern. Verify with a literal (non-regex) grep -c of the exact contiguous defect string against the file itself before declaring the guard clean.
